capabilities.name: Event V1 identity and local hash chain
capabilities.user_value: Canonical local event identity and provenance.
capabilities.failure_mode: Local integrity check can detect mutation; it does not establish real-world truth.
capabilities.security_implications: Preserve identity, timestamp, and provenance semantics; do not publish raw event data.

capabilities.name: Commitment V1
capabilities.user_value: Stable digest for third-party anchoring without exposing event contents.
capabilities.failure_mode: Changed canonicalization would break historical vectors; version is fixed and golden-tested.
capabilities.security_implications: Commitment is not proof of truth or authorship; use opaque persisted subject reference.

capabilities.name: Publication outbox and idempotency
dependencies: current SQLite Store connection and transaction boundary
capabilities.user_value: Durable local intent and controlled recovery across ambiguous network outcomes.
capabilities.operational_cost: Additional local tables and operator reconciliation.
capabilities.failure_mode: Single-process/store assumptions; multi-process safety is not established.
capabilities.security_implications: Attempt is durable before submit; ambiguous sends are not automatically replayed.

capabilities.name: Solana Memo adapter
capabilities.user_value: Publicly queryable timestamp anchor for a minimized digest.
capabilities.operational_cost: RPC availability, funding, key custody, and transaction fees.
capabilities.failure_mode: RPC may accept without confirmation; unknown outcomes require exact-signature reconciliation.
capabilities.security_implications: HTTPS, cluster allowlist, bounded RPC, minimized memo, signing bytes/version constraints; RPC is not independent proof.

capabilities.name: Receipts and verification
capabilities.user_value: Auditable lifecycle and explicit distinction between local binding and chain observation.
capabilities.operational_cost: Append-only receipt storage and later reconciliation.
capabilities.failure_mode: Configured RPC can lie or be unavailable; receipt cannot prove animal facts.
capabilities.security_implications: Correlate request/commitment/signature; immutable local receipts; MOCKED evidence never promoted to real chain claims.

capabilities.name: Historical hackathon demo and volatile publisher
capabilities.user_value: Useful for presentation and historical experiments.
capabilities.operational_cost: Not product-safe without durable state and truthful evidence labels.
capabilities.security_implications: Keep separated from core and label simulated behavior clearly.

capabilities.name: Real funded devnet run
capabilities.failure_mode: No airdrop signature obtained in this run.
capabilities.security_implications: No production/mainnet attempt; REAL_ON_CHAIN remains UNVERIFIED.

capabilities.name: Multi-process SQLite publication guarantees
capabilities.user_value: Would establish concurrency guarantees beyond current Store boundary.
capabilities.failure_mode: Not proven by current single-process tests.
